ja281:1.1: Abbhantaraṃ nāma dumo yassa dibbam idaṃ phalaṃ bhutvā dohaḷinī nārī cakkavattiṃ vijāyati.
ja281:2.1: Tvañ ca bhadde mahesī si sā cāsi patino piyā, āharissati te rājā idaṃ abbhantaraṃ phalan ti.
ja281:3.1: Bhattur atthe parakkanto yaṃ ṭhānam adhigacchati sūro attapariccāgī labhamāno bhavām' ahan ti.
